package.description: A simple tool that allows helpdesk technicians or non admin users to quickly unlock and reset passwords for user accounts without having to use the full AD Users & Computers MMC tool (assuming they have been delegated the required permissions).

en-US.description: A simple tool that allows helpdesk technicians or non admin users to quickly unlock and reset passwords for user accounts without having to use the full AD Users & Computers MMC tool (assuming they have been delegated the required permissions).
en-US.longDescription:
In many organizations IT administrators regularly need to unlock user accounts or reset passwords, but doing this through Active Directory Users & Computers MMC snap-in can be time consuming (or confusing for non IT staff that are not familiar with Active Directory but still need to reset other user's passwords). This tool was designed to provide a simple and intuitive tool for them to perform these actions with.

Features
- Simple and intuitive GUI
- Unlock accounts
- Reset passwords
- Force password to be changed on next logon
- Enable/Disable accounts
- Set account expiration date
- Multi-domain friendly - specify any domain and optionally use alternate credentials to connect to it
- Settings can be controlled via Group Policy
en-US.name: AD Account Reset Tool

zh-CN.description: 一款简易工具，使服务台技术人员或非管理员用户能够快速解锁并重置用户账户密码，而无需使用完整的 AD 用户与计算机 MMC 管理工具（前提是他们已被授予相应权限）。
zh-CN.longDescription:
在许多组织中，IT 管理员经常需要解锁用户账户或重置密码，但通过 Active Directory 用户和计算机 MMC 管理单元操作可能耗时（或让不熟悉 Active Directory 的非 IT 人员感到困惑，尽管他们仍需重置其他用户的密码）。此工具旨在为他们提供一个简单直观的解决方案来执行这些操作。

功能特点
- 简洁直观的图形界面
- 解锁账户
- 重置密码
- 强制下次登录时修改密码
- 启用/禁用账户
- 设置账户过期日期
- 支持多域环境——可指定任意域并选择使用备用凭证连接
- 支持通过组策略控制设置
